source_title: Justice Preview ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ Score With New Song ‘Pusher’
source_excerpt:
The official release for Justice ‘s long-awaited Grand Theft Auto VI score is here. The album will be released on December 11 and released on a triple LP and double CD.
“The scope of the game is so large geographically and thematically that it was clear from the beginning the music would also have to be very broad in terms of emotions, genres, and textures,” said Justice’s Xavier de Rosnay. “We were given the freedom to explore as many things as we needed to, musically speaking.”
To coincide with the release date announcement, the French duo has shared the latest offering from the album: “Pusher,” a collaboration with the French DJ Gesaffelstein. The seven-minute pulsing electronic track track shows off the breadth and diversity of sound one can expect from the highly anticipated score.
